note: Shared training-data picker serves twenty-field segmented plaque samples and ten-image whole-figure samples without masks. Text must not promise a fixed sample size or masks for every dataset. src remains the literal setting identifier.

records.key: A sample of a published model's training dataset. Sample sizes vary by dataset. Masks are included where available.
